item.title: Comment on Healthcare Scene Subscription Request by Alejandro Rodriguez
item.description: What are the most common issues with today's EMR and EHR I have a potential client in the government who will most likely ask me this question. What can we look forward to in innovation over the next five years that today's solutions currently don't offer?

item.title: Comment on Healthcare Scene Subscription Request by John
item.description: In reply to <a href="https://www.healthcarescene.com/healthcare-scene-subscription-request/#comment-33682">Alejandro Rodriguez</a>. Hi Alejandro, That's a loaded question that needs more than the comment space. I'd say the biggest complaint about EMR/EHR is that they're unusable for doctors. They were built as billing machines as opposed to care machines and so they bill great, but don't really move the needle on care. Looking forward, they're trying to evolve so they can impact care.
